# Tier `blackwell-2x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `dual-blackwell` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-26b-a4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 163840 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares a persistent **vLLM** agent seat, and the installer RENDERS it — the
llama-swap entry, the start/stop wrappers and the harness `agent_model` binding all derive from
one declaration, so the seat and the lane routing to it cannot disagree.

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| id | `qwen3.8-27b-vllm` | the llama-swap model id, `--served-model-name`, and what `agent_model` binds to |
| cards | `0,1` | `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, in PCI order |
| tensor_parallel | 2 | `--tensor-parallel-size`; must equal how many cards are listed |
| max_model_len | 163840 | the served window |
| kv_cache_dtype | `fp8` | KV precision — backend-dependent, not free everywhere |
| ttl_seconds | 300 | idle window before the seat unloads and frees its cards |
| launch | `windows-wsl` | which artifact set starts it |
| fallback | `qwen3.8-27b` | the llama.cpp seat a box WITHOUT the vLLM venv serves instead |

### Cache server

This seat is backed by a KV **cache server**: a context that leaves VRAM comes back from
the store instead of being recomputed, and it survives a seat swap.

| setting | value |
|---|---|
| store | `fs_native` |
| address | `/mnt/kvcache/lmcache-seat-tp2-fp8` |
| chunk_size | 1568 — must equal the engine's unified block size at this KV dtype |
| l1_staging_gb | 8 |
| key_prefix | `qube-seat-tp2-fp8` |
| min_mbps | 200 — below this the seat DEGRADES to the same-box L1 tier, loudly (0.115.1); it never refuses to start |

The store is a second device and stays **optional**: a box without one runs the seat on
VRAM plus the L1 staging buffer.

> The SAME seat blackwell-3x16 seeds, on the same silicon: the RTX 5060 Ti pair. On the 3-card reference box the pair is devices 0,2 (PCI order, the 5070 Ti display card sits at 1); on a 2-card box it is 0,1. Every operating-point number carries over unchanged — vLLM 0.28.0 + LMCache MP 0.5.5rc3, fp8 KV with the PR #4253 overlay, window 163,840 at util 0.90 (fp8 pool 177,766 tokens), batched 3135, seqs 32, the Lenovo fs_native cache server over the wired SMB path (570 MB/s, SEAT_L2_MIN_MBPS 200). Re-confirmed on the pair 2026-09-08 (Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-09-08-blackwell-2x16-fit/, arm P): util 0.85 -> Available KV cache memory 2.32 GiB = 141,266 tokens; non-KV 11.22 GiB per TP2 worker. HISTORY, so it is not repeated: harness 0.114.1 (same day, hours earlier) declared this tier had NO vllm_seat after an arm that spanned the 5070 Ti display card at a floor-respecting util 0.50 (Available KV -3.36 GiB). That arm answered a question this tier does not ask — the tier's two cards are the 5060 Ti pair, never the display card — and the operator overturned it the same afternoon. The display-card numbers stay in that record as the reason no seat is ever pinned to the 5070 Ti.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-8b` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> agent_ctx_tokens 163840 (2026-09-10) = the served window of the declared vLLM seat (was 131072, an under-declaration that sized every contract to 80 percent of the seat). No long twin on this tier: the third card is what buys the 262k window (blackwell-3x16.long_ctx_size). Config #16 (2x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5070 Ti 16GB ~896 GB/s + RTX 5060 Ti 16GB ~448 GB/s x8-electrical, PCIe Gen3 X299, quad-channel DDR4-3400, 128GB, no iGPU so the UTILITY card pays the desktop/DWM ~0.5-1.5GB tax). Full design + arithmetic: Drive Local-Offload-Harness/2026-08-02-blackwell-2x16-tier-research.md. TOPOLOGY IS PIN-DON'T-SPLIT: every seat fits one card and is pinned whole (splitting a fits-on-one-card model costs 20-33% tg — sequential per-token pipeline, harmonic-mean arithmetic, verified); the fast card holds the latency primaries + vision, the utility card holds the memory-stack residents + STT + desktop. The STT seat is residency=resident ON PURPOSE: it lives on the OTHER card, so it may run concurrently with any fast-card model — that concurrency is the second card's payoff for this route. DEVICE IDENTITY: pins are PCI_BUS_ID indices matching the reference box (0=5060 Ti, 1=5070 Ti); verify with nvidia-smi after any slot change or BIOS reset (this board wipes settings on AC loss) and substitute GPU UUIDs if enumeration moved — a silent flip inverts every placement. MEASURED verdicts carried from the single-GPU era and still binding: self-built CUDA 12.8 sm_120 build mandatory; no spec-decode except where llama.cpp has the model's MTP graph (Qwen3.5/3.6 yes, DeepSeek-class measured dead here); mmap (never --no-mmap/--mlock) for 70GB+ models + a warm-up request + a wait-for-RAM guard; all-experts-CPU wins for V4-Flash-class MoE until an -ot A/B on THIS Gen3-x8 link proves otherwise; -b/-ub 2048, threads 18; q4_0 KV banned; vision mmproj F16 only. SEAT LIFECYCLE (house rule 2026-08-02): every seat here is the measured INCUMBENT; challengers enter ONLY via documented bake-off in Benchmarks and Optimizations/. SEAT VERDICTS LANDED (2026-08-12..14, tier-matrix catch-up): IMAGE incumbent is now Krea 2 Turbo bf16 (24.5GB, 8-step turbo recipe) — won the blinded 32GB bake-off 2-0-2 over Qwen-Image-2512 (editorial + text-rendering pairs; record in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-14-nightshift4-notes.md), bound via DisTorch2 ratio pooling (the imagegen_pool_* seed keys; --disable-dynamic-vram stays mandatory on both launch surfaces) in harness 0.59.0. HiDream-O1 leaves this tier's seat but REMAINS the proven binding for every single-16GB tier (24.5GB does not fit one card — do not propagate the krea2 seed downward). VIDEO seat BOUND 2026-08-14/15 (Seat Frontier Leg 3, executing the 2026-08-12 verdict; binding mode DECIDED BY OPERATOR 2026-08-15): videogen_family=ltx25 — LTX-2.5 22B distilled int8, two-pass latent-upscale joint-AV graph, POOLED per house doctrine AT REDUCED RESOLUTION (1280x704@24fps — the doctrine outranks the resolution). Measured constraint driving this: the int8 transformer UPCASTS TO BF16 AT COMPUTE = 39.11GB LOADED (DisTorch's own analysis), exceeding the 32GB physical pool — at 1920x1088 no virtual_vram_gb value fits weights AND full-res stage-2 activations (three renders OOM'd). At 1280x704 with videogen_pool_vvram_gb=30 the pooled render is behavior-proven: 5.04s + AAC joint audio in 189.8s, donor 11.8GiB + compute 10.5GiB live, zero OOM. Pooled serving still requires the --disable-dynamic-vram launch flag (MultiGPU #191). Full-res 1920x1088 remains reachable via the STREAMING alternative (pool keys unset, dynamic VRAM on — measured 210s and 1.65-2.3x faster for bf16 graphs) as a per-deployment choice; this tier seeds the doctrine-conformant pooled recipe. Wan 2.2 weights stay on disk as the --model wan fallback family. CODER+AGENT seats DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Seat Frontier Leg 1, measured): Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (16.7GB pooled, thinking) WON both — coder vs Qwen3-Coder-30B (v3 decision set 14/16 vs 7/16; actioneval e2e 9/9 vs 7/9; loser's GGUF deleted per the disk rule) and agent vs the 31B-agent seat (custody paired D1 tie 15/15-15/15 at -39% output tokens / -31% wall; actioneval 9/9 vs 8/9; 31B-agent entry kept as rollback).
